title: Fix Vite Config Node Strip Parameter Properties
description: mit-bestand demonstrator:dev fails loading ⚙️vite.config.ts because Node strip-only TypeScript rejects constructor parameter properties in 🧩framework/⚡️implementation/🟦️typescript/📦️index.ts (pulled in via os/dev script → @semio-tech/framework-core). Fix at root so vite config import graph is compatible and demonstrator/dev starts.
summary: Node 24/Vite 7 native configLoader (strip-only TS) rejected constructor parameter properties when loading mit-bestand demonstrator ⚙️vite.config.ts via os/dev helpers. Forced --configLoader bundle on all bun/bunx vite spawns in repo lib (withViteConfigLoader) and on direct vite build runCmdStatus sites in demonstrator + os/dev. Verified: SKIP_PLUGIN_BUILD=1 demonstrator:dev → Vite ready on :6029 with HTTP 200.
